confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately confident. Hotel and hostel anchors are least certain because July rates in Los Angeles vary widely with events and demand. Restaurant figures are typical menu prices, not adjusted for tax or tip. The FX value comes from a search snippet attributed to the RBA exchange rates page for 4pm on 15 October 2026. I did not open that page directly, and the source_url is the RBA's standard exchange-rates page. A conflicting RBA homepage snippet showed 0.7002 for 14 October, so the FX observation should be verified before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Values are benchmarked against general knowledge of large US coastal tourism cities such as San Francisco, San Diego and Seattle, adjusted for Los Angeles pricing and July summer hotel demand. Cocktail and wine anchors were sanity-checked against the beer anchor.
